title: Inert extraction from extended enriched interval strings
statement:
Let $\mathcal V$ be any monoidal infinity category in containing universes. Use $p:\mathrm{Str}(\mathcal V)\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$, $a:\mathrm{Str}^+(\mathcal V)\to\mathrm{Str}(\mathcal V)$ and $e:\mathrm{Str}^+(\mathcal V)\to\mathcal V^\otimes$ as explicitly defined in [def-coef-enriched-interval-strings]. The map $a$ is a trivial Kan fibration: every compatible lifting problem for $\partial\Delta^s\hookrightarrow\Delta^s$, including $s=0$, has a solution. The evaluation functor $e$ sends every edge whose image under $a$ is $p$-cocartesian over an inert map to an inert edge of $\mathcal V^\otimes$.

For an interval string with adjacent action maps $M_{i-1}\otimes V_i\to M_i$, the value of $e$ is the tuple $(V_1,\ldots,V_n)$. On the cocartesian transport that collapses consecutive intervals, its output operation is tensoring the adjacent action maps and composing them in their interval order. A repeated endpoint uses the tensor unit and the identity action. These descriptions include the naturality simplices and the substitution and unit coherence simplices of the interval diagrams; the constructions commute with restriction to subintervals. No internal Hom, universal evaluation map, closure, or presentability is assumed.
